author: Yffe
content: Root cause confirmed: depth guard in parse_expr is correctly placed (all nested-expr re-entries route through it), but MAX_EXPR_DEPTH=256 exceeds the 2 MiB test-thread native stack. Empirically a debug build overflows the C stack at ~135-140 ladder levels (~10 frames/level), so the depth-256 guard never fires before SIGABRT. Plan: lower MAX_EXPR_DEPTH 256->64 in parser.rs (single file), ~2x margin below the overflow point; deep nesting now returns the structured ExpressionTooDeep diagnostic. Un-ignore divergence_deep_nesting_no_panic after green gauntlet. No assertions/fixtures touched.
